readme: Every confirmed DROP verdict ever made, keyed (id, store, normalised item), applied by verify-apply on EVERY run regardless of which week produced it. Exists because only the current week's verdict file used to be read, so the same wrong products returned as soon as their week rolled over - 18 previously-dropped cells were live again on 2026-07-29, three as crowns. Entries are added automatically when a drop's item identity is CONFIRMED (verdict item field or reason quote matches the cell), and removed automatically when a later keep verdict overturns one. Do not hand-edit item_norm; it is Get-VerdictNorm's output (verdict-lib.ps1).

suppressions.item_norm: snapple juice drink variety pack
suppressions.item: Snapple Juice Drink Variety Pack
suppressions.reason: 'Snapple Juice Drink Variety Pack' is an assorted juice-drink beverage multipack, not apple juice.

suppressions.item_norm: lady apples
suppressions.item: Lady Apples
suppressions.reason: 'Lady Apples' are a tiny ornamental/specialty crabapple-type variety, not the eating apples a shopper means.

suppressions.item_norm: cucumber avocado roll 15 pcs
suppressions.item: Cucumber Avocado Roll, 15 pcs
suppressions.reason: 'Cucumber Avocado Roll, 15 pcs' is prepared sushi, not avocados.

suppressions.item_norm: pork loin filet
suppressions.item: Pork Loin Filet
suppressions.reason: Smithfield 'Pork Loin Filet' is a marinated pork loin, not sliced bacon

suppressions.item_norm: smithfield applewood smoked bacon fresh pork loin filet
suppressions.item: Smithfield Applewood Smoked Bacon Fresh Pork Loin Filet
suppressions.reason: 'Smithfield Applewood Smoked Bacon Fresh Pork Loin Filet' is a seasoned pork loin filet, not sliced bacon.

suppressions.item_norm: simple truth protein black pepper lentils brown rice and ancient grains whole grain blend
suppressions.item: Simple Truth Protein Black Pepper Lentils Brown Rice and Ancient Grains Whole Grain Blend
suppressions.reason: Not black pepper. 'Simple Truth Protein Black Pepper Lentils Brown Rice and Ancient Grains Whole Grain Blend' is a seasoned grain side dish; 'black pepper' is a flavour word in its name. It was crowning the spice at $0.34/oz.

suppressions.item_norm: broccoli normandy
suppressions.item: Broccoli Normandy
suppressions.reason: 'Broccoli Normandy' is a mixed vegetable blend (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots), not fresh broccoli.

suppressions.item_norm: chophouse cajun seasoning with jalapeno
suppressions.item: Chophouse Cajun Seasoning with Jalapeno
suppressions.reason: A jalapeno-flavoured variant, and the number is not credible: 12 oz at $0.0833/oz = $1.00 for a 12 oz shaker against $4.58 for the 16 oz runner-up. Almost certainly a bad price/size parse - drop rather than publish a 71%-below-runner-up crown.

suppressions.item_norm: hy vee short cuts pineapple chunks
suppressions.item: Hy-Vee Short Cuts pineapple chunks
suppressions.reason: Fresh-cut produce, not canned. 'Hy-Vee Short Cuts pineapple chunks' is the refrigerated cut-fruit tub, and the captured line is a fuel-saver ad string quoting $4.99 lb.

suppressions.item_norm: member s mark pinto beans 12 lbs
suppressions.item: Member's Mark Pinto Beans 12 lbs.
suppressions.reason: 'Member's Mark Pinto Beans 12 lbs.' is a 12-lb bag of DRY pinto beans, not canned beans. No 192 oz can exists. Dry beans are not per-oz comparable to canned and it is currently the cheapest entry.

suppressions.item_norm: friskies prime filets with chicken tuna in gravy 5 5 oz
suppressions.item: Friskies Prime Filets with Chicken & Tuna in Gravy 5.5 Oz
suppressions.reason: 'Friskies Prime Filets with Chicken & Tuna in Gravy 5.5 Oz' is WET canned cat food; commodity is Cat Food (dry).

suppressions.item_norm: cheez it club toasted or town house crackers 12 to 21 oz
suppressions.item: Cheez-It, Club, Toasted or Town House crackers, 12 to 21 oz.
suppressions.reason: Combined multi-product ad line: 'Cheez-It, Club, Toasted or Town House crackers, 12 to 21 oz.' Club/Town House/Toasted are plain buttery crackers, not cheese crackers, and the size range makes the unit price arbitrary.

suppressions.item_norm: hy vee ravioli or tortellini 42 or 48 oz 5 99
suppressions.item: Hy-Vee ravioli or tortellini, 42 or 48 oz., $5.99
suppressions.reason: Combined A-or-B ad line with a size range: 'Hy-Vee ravioli or tortellini, 42 or 48 oz., $5.99'. Neither which product nor which size is determinable, so the per-ounce price is a coin flip.

suppressions.item_norm: lunch buddies mixed fruit in black cherry gel bowls 4 3 oz
suppressions.item: Lunch Buddies Mixed Fruit IN Black Cherry Gel Bowls 4 3 OZ
suppressions.reason: Not fresh cherries: "Black Cherry Gel Bowls" is a shelf-stable gelatin fruit cup, a different product priced per lb against fresh fruit.

suppressions.item_norm: trumoo whole chocolate milk half gallon
suppressions.item: TruMoo Whole Chocolate Milk Half Gallon
suppressions.reason: Internal contradiction: item is 'TruMoo Whole Chocolate Milk Half Gallon' but size recorded as 'gallon', so the per-floz price is halved (0.0255/floz = $1.63 a half gallon, well below market). Bad size parse makes it the false cheapest.

suppressions.item_norm: member s mark shrimp tray with cocktail sauce priced per pound
suppressions.item: Member's Mark Shrimp Tray with Cocktail Sauce, priced per pound
suppressions.reason: 'Member's Mark Shrimp Tray with Cocktail Sauce, priced per pound' is a shrimp platter, not a bottle of cocktail sauce; price is per lb of shrimp.

suppressions.item_norm: califia farms organic coconut milk
suppressions.item: Califia Farms Organic Coconut Milk
suppressions.reason: Carton beverage, not canned cooking milk. 'Califia Farms Organic Coconut Milk' is the refrigerated drinking carton; this commodity is the thick canned milk used for cooking. Different products, different per-ounce economics.

suppressions.item_norm: stok cold brew coffee black unsweetened 48 fl oz
suppressions.item: Stok Cold Brew Coffee Black Unsweetened 48 FL OZ
suppressions.reason: Liquid, not ground. 'Stok Cold Brew Coffee Black Unsweetened 48 FL OZ' is ready-to-drink cold brew; comparing its fluid ounces against ground coffee's dry ounces is why it read 66% under the runner-up.

suppressions.item_norm: corn dogs hot
suppressions.item: Corn Dogs Hot
suppressions.reason: 'Corn Dogs Hot' 1 ea is a hot deli/prepared corn dog, not the frozen packaged product the commodity means.

suppressions.item_norm: lance variety pack sandwich crackers
suppressions.item: Lance Variety Pack Sandwich Crackers
suppressions.reason: 'Lance Variety Pack Sandwich Crackers' are filled cracker sandwiches (peanut butter/cheese), a different snack product than saltine/buttery crackers.

suppressions.item_norm: burman s spicy brown mustard 12 oz
suppressions.item: Burman S Spicy Brown Mustard 12 OZ
suppressions.reason: Not dijon: "Spicy Brown Mustard" is a different mustard style.

suppressions.item_norm: lysol wipes or disinfectant spray 80 ct or 12 5 oz 5 99
suppressions.item: Lysol wipes or disinfectant spray, 80 ct. or 12.5 oz., $5.99
suppressions.reason: 'Lysol wipes or disinfectant spray, 80 ct. or 12.5 oz., $5.99' is a combined multi-product ad line (wipes OR spray); per-wipe price is an assumption, not a stated wipes price.

suppressions.item_norm: parsley 2 oz
suppressions.item: Parsley 2 OZ
suppressions.reason: Cannot tell fresh from dried. The captured name is just 'Parsley 2 OZ' with no brand - Aldi sells both a Stonemill dried jar and a fresh clamshell in that weight, and at 76% under the runner-up the two readings give very different answers. Dropped rather than publish a guess; dried-parsley still has six other stores.

suppressions.item_norm: simply nature organic basil stir in paste 2 8 oz
suppressions.item: Simply Nature Organic Basil Stir IN Paste 2.8 OZ
suppressions.reason: Not fresh basil: a Basil Stir-In PASTE in a tube, not the fresh herb the commodity means.

suppressions.item_norm: happy harvest french green beans 14 5 oz
suppressions.item: Happy Harvest French Green Beans 14.5 OZ
suppressions.reason: Canned, not fresh. 'Happy Harvest French Green Beans 14.5 OZ' is Aldi's canned-vegetable label; this commodity is fresh green beans priced per pound. It was 49% under the runner-up because a can of beans is not a pound of produce.

suppressions.item_norm: frozen carrots crinkle cut
suppressions.item: Frozen Carrots, Crinkle Cut
suppressions.reason: 'Frozen Carrots, Crinkle Cut' is CARROTS, not french fries

suppressions.item_norm: frozen carrots crinkle cut our family steamable
suppressions.item: Frozen Carrots, Crinkle Cut Our Family Steamable
suppressions.reason: Item is 'Frozen Carrots, Crinkle Cut Our Family Steamable' - crinkle-cut CARROTS, not French fries. Wrong product matched on 'crinkle cut'.

suppressions.item_norm: seeds of change certified organic quinoa and brown rice with garlic
suppressions.item: Seeds of Change Certified Organic Quinoa and Brown Rice with Garlic
suppressions.reason: 'Seeds of Change Certified Organic Quinoa and Brown Rice with Garlic' is a heat-and-eat rice pouch multipack, not fresh garlic bulbs.

suppressions.item_norm: bellatoria ultra thin pizza or garlic bread 11 81 to 19 41 oz 2 10
suppressions.item: Bellatoria ultra thin pizza or garlic bread, 11.81 to 19.41 oz., 2/$10
suppressions.reason: 'Bellatoria ultra thin pizza or garlic bread, 11.81 to 19.41 oz., 2/$10' is a combined multi-product ad line (pizza OR garlic bread) with an ambiguous size; not a clean garlic-bread price.

suppressions.item_norm: grape nuts original 64 oz
suppressions.item: Grape Nuts Original, 64 oz.
suppressions.reason: 'Grape Nuts Original, 64 oz.' is breakfast CEREAL, not fresh grapes

suppressions.item_norm: tuscan garden manzanilla olives stuffed with pimiento 10 oz
suppressions.item: Tuscan Garden Manzanilla Olives Stuffed With Pimiento 10 OZ
suppressions.reason: Size basis unresolvable: the card says 15.8 oz (net, with brine) but ALDI's own product name says 10 oz (drained). The board priced the 15.8 oz basis ($0.1449/oz); against the 10 oz the store names it is $0.229/oz, which is what its own product page shows. Dropping rather than publishing the cheaper of two bases.

suppressions.item_norm: kroger rich n honey hot dog buns
suppressions.item: Kroger Rich N Honey Hot Dog Buns
suppressions.reason: Not honey. 'Kroger Rich N Honey Hot Dog Buns' is bread that matched on the word honey.

suppressions.item_norm: la costena whole jalapeno peppers
suppressions.item: La Costena Whole Jalapeno Peppers
suppressions.reason: Canned, not fresh. 'La Costena Whole Jalapeno Peppers' is the canned pepper; fresh jalapenos are the commodity here and pickled/canned ones already have their own row (pickled-jalapenos).

suppressions.reason: Combined multi-product ad line ("bagels, protein bagels or muffin tops") and muffin tops are not muffins.

suppressions.reason: Combined multi-product ad line (three different cleaners) with a 14.5-32 oz size RANGE - no single size to price.

suppressions.item: Earthly Grains Parmesan Couscous 5.9 OZ
suppressions.reason: Not parmesan cheese: "Parmesan Couscous" is a boxed couscous side dish.

suppressions.item_norm: cheez it duoz sharp cheddar and parmesan cheese crackers
suppressions.item: Cheez-It DUOZ Sharp Cheddar and Parmesan Cheese Crackers
suppressions.reason: Cheese CRACKERS, not parmesan cheese.

suppressions.item_norm: mama cozzis pesto burrata
suppressions.item: Mama Cozzis Pesto Burrata
suppressions.reason: Not pesto. 'Mama Cozzis Pesto Burrata' is a refrigerated pizza/burrata item, and its captured size (1815 OZ) is a mangled decimal we could not prove, so the per-ounce price is unsound as well.

suppressions.item_norm: mild jalapeno slices
suppressions.item: Mild Jalapeno Slices
suppressions.reason: Mt Olive 'Mild Jalapeno Slices' are pickled jalapenos, not dill pickles

suppressions.item: Dole Pineapple, 8 oz
suppressions.reason: 'Dole Pineapple, 8 oz' at $1 is a packaged/canned pineapple cup, not a whole fresh pineapple (commodity unit is each, whole). It was winning the cell at $1 vs ~$1.89-$4.99 for real whole pineapples.

suppressions.item_norm: fareway chunk pineapple
suppressions.item: Fareway Chunk Pineapple
suppressions.reason: Cut/canned chunks, not a whole pineapple. This commodity is a whole pineapple priced per each; 'Fareway Chunk Pineapple' is a container of pieces.

suppressions.item: Frito-Lay snacks, salsa or queso dip, 8.25 to 24 oz., $3.99 ea. with purchase of 3

suppressions.item: Pace salsa, picante sauce or queso bowls, 11 to 22 oz., 2/ $5.00

suppressions.item_norm: bomb pop extremes super sour blue raspberry ice pops
suppressions.item: Bomb Pop Extremes Super Sour Blue Raspberry Ice Pops
suppressions.reason: Not fruit. 'Bomb Pop Extremes Super Sour Blue Raspberry Ice Pops' is a freezer novelty that matched on 'raspberry'.

suppressions.item_norm: dill relish
suppressions.item: Dill Relish
suppressions.reason: DILL relish; the commodity is Sweet Relish, which is a different product at a different price point.

suppressions.item: Ibp Ribeye Beef Steak Burgers 1.33 Lb
suppressions.reason: Not a ribeye steak: "Ribeye Beef STEAK BURGERS" are ground-beef patties.

suppressions.item: Fremont Fish Market Jumbo Butterfly Shrimp 9 OZ
suppressions.reason: Not raw shrimp: "Jumbo Butterfly Shrimp" is a breaded frozen prepared item; commodity is frozen RAW shrimp.

suppressions.item: Birds Eye Chopped Spinach
suppressions.reason: Frozen, not fresh. 'Birds Eye Chopped Spinach' is a freezer box; this commodity is fresh spinach. Frozen spinach is several times denser per ounce, so it undercuts fresh on a per-ounce board without being the same purchase.

suppressions.item_norm: kroger strawberry applesauce
suppressions.item: Kroger Strawberry Applesauce
suppressions.reason: Not fruit. 'Kroger Strawberry Applesauce' matched on 'strawberry' and was crowning fresh berries at $0.083/oz.

suppressions.item_norm: mission sun dried tomato basil wraps 6ct
suppressions.item: Mission Sun-Dried Tomato Basil Wraps 6Ct
suppressions.reason: Not sun-dried tomatoes. 'Mission Sun-Dried Tomato Basil Wraps 6Ct' is flavoured tortillas.

suppressions.item_norm: ball park sesame seed burger buns 8 count
suppressions.item: Ball Park Sesame Seed Burger Buns, 8 Count
suppressions.reason: Not sesame seeds. 'Ball Park Sesame Seed Burger Buns, 8 Count' is bread.

suppressions.item_norm: hy vee tomatoes 28 or 29 oz
suppressions.item: Hy-Vee tomatoes, 28 or 29 oz.
suppressions.reason: 'Hy-Vee tomatoes, 28 or 29 oz.' is the standard CANNED tomato size - canned product under a fresh-tomato (per lb) commodity

suppressions.item: Guerrero fajita 20 ct. or burrito tortillas 8 ct., $2.49
suppressions.reason: Combined ad line offering two different counts (20 ct OR 8 ct) at one price - the per-tortilla price depends on which you buy.

suppressions.item_norm: tortilla style
suppressions.item: Tortilla Style
suppressions.reason: Quest 'Tortilla Style' Protein Chips are snack chips, not flour tortillas; false winner at $0.11
